phase: Phase 3 — Build Beautiful Websites with CSS
description: Understand how to target HTML elements.
definition: Classes and identifiers let C S S select particular elements.
rule: A dot selects a class; a hash selects an identifier.
tip: Reuse a class to apply the same style to several elements.
caution: Keep identifiers unique, and avoid unnecessary selector specificity.
exercise: Style two elements with one shared class.
